description: Rules are called The Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011 and came into force on 1 April 2011.
expected_value_or_format: Rule title: The Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011; commencement: 01-04-2011.

description: Rule 2 defines the terms used throughout these Rules, including Act, dealer, lot, manufacturer, maximum permissible error, net quantity, packer, principal display panel, quantity, retail dealer, retail package, retail sale, retail sale price, section, Schedule, standard package, wholesale dealer and wholesale package. Undefined terms that are defined in the Act have the meanings assigned in the Act.
expected_value_or_format: Definitions shall be interpreted according to Rule 2; wholesale package includes the categories specified in Rule 2(r).

legal_reference.schedule_reference: First Schedule is incorporated into the definition of maximum permissible error.

description: Chapter II does not apply to packages containing more than 25 kg or 25 litre, except cement and fertilizer sold in bags up to 50 kg.

applicability.commodity_category: Packaged commodities intended for retail sale
applicability.exemption_conditions: Packages containing more than 25 kg or 25 litre are outside Chapter II; exception stated for cement and fertilizer sold in bags up to 50 kg.

expected_value_or_format: Chapter II applicability must be excluded when quantity >25 kg or >25 litre, subject to the stated cement/fertilizer exception.

description: Chapter II does not apply to packaged commodities meant for industrial consumers or institutional consumers.

applicability.commodity_category: Packaged commodities meant for industrial or institutional consumers
applicability.exemption_conditions: Industrial and institutional consumer packages are excluded from Chapter II.

expected_value_or_format: Chapter II applicability = excluded for industrial/institutional consumer packages.

description: A person shall not pre-pack or cause or permit a commodity to be pre-packed for sale, distribution or delivery unless the package or securely affixed label bears the declarations required by the Rules.

applicability.exemption_conditions: Packages covered by Chapter II; manufacturer-premises exception concerning absence of retail sale price is stated separately.

expected_value_or_format: All declarations required by the Rules must be present on the package or securely affixed label.

description: Packages existing without a retail sale price declaration within the manufacturer's premises are not treated as violating the Rules, but all packages leaving the manufacturer's premises for destination must bear the required retail sale price declaration.

applicability.exemption_conditions: Temporary absence of retail sale price is permitted while packages remain within the manufacturer's premises.

expected_value_or_format: Retail sale price declaration must be present when package leaves manufacturer's premises.

description: Commodities specified in the Second Schedule shall be packed for sale, distribution or delivery in the standard quantities specified in that Schedule.

applicability.commodity_category: Commodities specified in the Second Schedule
applicability.exemption_conditions: Applies to commodities listed in the Second Schedule.

expected_value_or_format: Package quantity must correspond to the applicable standard quantity specified in the Second Schedule.

description: The source contains a proviso requiring a prominent declaration that the package is not a standard pack size when a Second Schedule commodity is packed in a size other than prescribed. The source expressly states that this proviso was withdrawn with effect from 01.07.2012.

applicability.commodity_category: Commodities specified in the Second Schedule packed in non-prescribed sizes
applicability.exemption_conditions: Historical requirement only; source states withdrawal effective 01.07.2012.

expected_value_or_format: Historical declaration: 'Not a standard pack size under the Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011' or 'non standard size under the Legal Metrology (packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011'.

description: Every package must bear a definite, plain and conspicuous declaration in accordance with Chapter II.

applicability.commodity_category: Every package covered by Chapter II
applicability.exemption_conditions: Subject to specific exemptions/provisos in Rule 6.

expected_value_or_format: Required declarations must be definite, plain and conspicuous.

description: The package must declare the name and address of the manufacturer; where the manufacturer is not the packer, the name and address of both manufacturer and packer; and for an imported package, the name and address of the importer.

applicability.exemption_conditions: Food articles are subject to the alternative requirement identified in Rule 6(1)(a) Explanation III.

expected_value_or_format: Manufacturer name/address; manufacturer + packer name/address where applicable; importer name/address for imported packages.

description: Where a company name and address appears without qualifying words such as 'manufactured by' or 'packed by', it is presumed to be the manufacturer's name and address.

applicability.exemption_conditions: Applies to interpretation of company name/address appearing on the label.

expected_value_or_format: Unqualified company name/address is treated as manufacturer identification.

description: Where the brand name and address of the brand owner appear on the label as marketer, the brand owner is held responsible for violations and action may be initiated against the deemed manufacturer; where multiple names and addresses appear, prosecution is to be launched against the manufacturer indicated first.

applicability.exemption_conditions: Applies where the specified label-identification circumstances exist.

expected_value_or_format: Brand-owner/marketer identification and ordering of manufacturer identification operate as specified in Explanation II.

description: For packages containing food articles, the Rule 6(1)(a) manufacturer/packer/importer requirement does not apply; the source states that the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954 and rules made thereunder apply instead.

applicability.exemption_conditions: Specific Rule 6(1)(a) requirement displaced by the alternative legal framework identified in the source.

expected_value_or_format: Apply the alternative requirement stated by Rule 6(1)(a), Explanation III.

description: The common or generic name of the commodity must be mentioned; for packages containing more than one product, the name and number or quantity of each product must be mentioned.

applicability.exemption_conditions: No specific exemption stated in the cited clause.

expected_value_or_format: Common/generic commodity name; for multiple products, each product's name and number/quantity.

description: The net quantity must be mentioned in the standard unit of weight or measure; where the commodity is packed or sold by number, the number of commodities must be mentioned.

applicability.exemption_conditions: Subject to Rule 12 and the Fourth Schedule.

expected_value_or_format: Net quantity expressed using applicable standard unit of weight/measure, or number where sold by number.

description: The month and year in which the commodity is manufactured, pre-packed or imported must be mentioned.

applicability.exemption_conditions: Specific exemptions are provided for bidis, incense sticks, specified domestic LPG cylinders, seeds, food products and cosmetics under the provisos.

expected_value_or_format: Month and year of manufacture/pre-packing/import must be declared unless a stated exemption applies.

description: The month/year declaration requirement does not apply to packages containing bidis or incense sticks.

applicability.exemption_conditions: Specific exemption from month/year manufacture or pre-packing declaration.

expected_value_or_format: Month/year manufacture or pre-packing declaration may be omitted.

description: The month/year manufacture or pre-packing declaration requirement does not apply to domestic LPG cylinders of 14.2 kg or 5 kg bottled and marketed by a public sector undertaking.

applicability.commodity_category: Domestic LPG cylinders of 14.2 kg or 5 kg bottled and marketed by a public sector undertaking

expected_value_or_format: Month/year manufacture or pre-packing declaration may be omitted.

description: Packaging material bearing the month in which a commodity was expected to be pre-packed may be used for the concerned commodity during the next succeeding month if not exhausted during the indicated month, and may be extended by the Central Government where circumstances beyond the manufacturer's or packer's control prevented exhaustion.

applicability.commodity_category: Packaging material bearing a pre-packing month
applicability.exemption_conditions: Not applicable to food products where the Best before/Use before period is 90 days or less from manufacture/packing.

expected_value_or_format: Packaging material may roll over only to the next succeeding month, subject to the source's conditions and exception.

description: The retail sale price declaration is not required on packages containing bidi.

applicability.exemption_conditions: Specific exemption from retail sale price declaration.

expected_value_or_format: MRP declaration may be omitted.

description: The retail sale price declaration is not required on domestic LPG cylinders whose price is covered under the Government's Administrative Price Mechanism.

applicability.commodity_category: Domestic LPG cylinders covered by the Administrative Price Mechanism

expected_value_or_format: MRP declaration may be omitted.

description: The month and year in which a commodity is pre-packed may be expressed in words, numerals indicating month and year, or both.

applicability.commodity_category: Commodities for which month/year declaration is required
applicability.exemption_conditions: Does not override specific exemptions from the month/year declaration.

expected_value_or_format: Month/year expressed as words, numerals, or both.

description: Every package must bear the name, address, telephone number and, if available, email address of the person or office that can be contacted for consumer complaints.

applicability.commodity_category: Every package covered by Chapter II
applicability.exemption_conditions: No specific exemption stated in the cited sub-rule.

expected_value_or_format: Name + address + telephone number + email address if available.

description: Individual stickers may not be affixed to a package for altering or making declarations required under the Rules.

applicability.exemption_conditions: A sticker with a revised lower MRP inclusive of all taxes is permitted, provided it does not cover the original MRP declaration.

expected_value_or_format: No sticker-based alteration/addition of required declarations, except permitted reduced-MRP sticker.

description: A sticker with a revised lower MRP inclusive of all taxes may be affixed, but it must not cover the MRP declaration made by the manufacturer or packer.

applicability.commodity_category: Packages whose MRP is being reduced
applicability.exemption_conditions: Only reduction of MRP is covered by this sticker permission.

expected_value_or_format: Revised lower MRP sticker is permitted and must not obscure original MRP declaration.

description: Stickers may be used for declarations other than declarations required under the Rules.

applicability.exemption_conditions: Only declarations outside those required by the Rules may be made through stickers.

expected_value_or_format: Sticker permitted only for non-Legal-Metrology-required declarations.

description: For a commodity consisting of multiple components packed in two or more units and sold as one commodity, the declarations under Rule 6(1) must appear on the main package, which must also carry information about accompanying packages; alternatively, declarations may be placed on individual packages with intimation on the main package.

applicability.commodity_category: Multi-component commodities packed in two or more units
applicability.exemption_conditions: Where components are sold as spare parts, all declarations must be given on each package.

expected_value_or_format: Required declarations on main package plus accompanying-package information, or permitted individual-package declaration arrangement.

description: Where components are sold as spare parts, all required declarations must be given on each package.

applicability.exemption_conditions: Applies to spare-part components within the multi-unit provision.

expected_value_or_format: All required declarations present on each individual spare-part package.

description: Unused packaging material/wrapper could historically be used until 31.03.2012 or until exhausted, whichever was earlier, after corrections required under the Rules by stamping, sticker or online printing. The source notes that the date was extended by GSR 734(E) dated 30.09.2011.

applicability.exemption_conditions: Historical transitional provision; source specifies the period.

expected_value_or_format: Historical transitional use subject to correction of declarations.

description: For a package having capacity of 5 cubic centimetres or less, the principal display panel may be a card or tape affixed firmly to the package and bearing the required information.
expected_value_or_format: Firmly affixed card or tape may constitute the principal display panel and must bear required information.

legal_reference.schedule_reference: Table I / Table II under Rule 7(2)

description: For net quantity declared by weight or volume, the height of numerals on the principal display panel must meet the minimum heights in Table I.

applicability.commodity_category: Packages with net quantity declared by weight or volume
applicability.exemption_conditions: Rule 7(4) provides an exception where the same information is required by another law.

expected_value_or_format: Up to 200 g/ml: 1 mm normal, 2 mm blown/formed/molded/embossed/perforated; >200 to 500 g/ml: 2 mm, 4 mm; >500 g/ml: 4 mm, 6 mm.

description: For net quantity declared by length, area or number, numeral height must meet Table II according to the area of the principal display panel.

applicability.commodity_category: Packages with net quantity declared by length, area or number
applicability.exemption_conditions: Rule 7(4) provides an exception where the same information is required by another law.

expected_value_or_format: PDP up to 100 cm2: 1/2 mm; >100 to 500 cm2: 2/4 mm; >500 to 2500 cm2: 4/6 mm; >2500 cm2: 6/6 mm, normal/blown etc. respectively.

description: Letters in declarations must be at least 1 mm high; when blown, formed, molded, embossed or perforated, letters must be at least 2 mm high.
expected_value_or_format: Letter height >=1 mm; >=2 mm when blown/formed/molded/embossed/perforated.

description: The width of a letter or numeral must not be less than one-third of its height, except numeral 1 and letters i, I and l.

applicability.exemption_conditions: Exceptions are numeral '1' and letters '(i), (I) and (l)'.

expected_value_or_format: Width >= one-third of height, except specified characters.

description: Rule 7(1)-(3) do not apply where the information required under Rule 7 is also required to be given by or under another law in force.

applicability.commodity_category: Packages where the same information is mandated by another law
applicability.exemption_conditions: Information must also be required by or under another law.

expected_value_or_format: Rule 7(1)-(3) applicability = exempt when identical information is required by another law.

description: Every declaration required under the Rules must appear on the principal display panel.

applicability.exemption_conditions: Subject to the specific placement provisions in Rule 8.

expected_value_or_format: Required declarations located on principal display panel.

description: The area surrounding the quantity declaration must be free from printed information: above and below by at least the height of the numeral, and left and right by at least twice the numeral height.

applicability.exemption_conditions: Applies to the quantity declaration area.

expected_value_or_format: Vertical clearance >= numeral height; horizontal clearance >= 2 x numeral height.

description: For returnable bottles used for soft drinks, ready-to-serve fruit beverages or similar products, MRP may be indicated on the crown cap, bottle, or both; when indicated on crown cap or bottle, the form 'MRP Rs....' is sufficient.

applicability.commodity_category: Soft drinks, ready-to-serve fruit beverages or like commodities in consumer-returnable refillable bottles

expected_value_or_format: MRP on crown cap, bottle, or both; 'MRP Rs....' is sufficient.

description: Every package declaration must be legible and prominent.
expected_value_or_format: Declaration is legible and prominent.

description: Numerals of the retail sale price and net quantity declarations must be printed, painted or inscribed in a colour that contrasts conspicuously with the background of the label.

applicability.commodity_category: Packages bearing MRP and net quantity
applicability.exemption_conditions: Blown, formed or molded label information on glass or plastic need not use contrasting colour.

expected_value_or_format: MRP and net-quantity numerals use conspicuously contrasting colour unless stated glass/plastic exception applies.

description: Where label information is blown, formed or molded on a glass or plastic surface, contrasting colour is not required.

applicability.commodity_category: Packages with blown/formed/molded glass or plastic label information

expected_value_or_format: Contrast-colour requirement is not mandatory for specified glass/plastic information.

description: Handwritten or hand-script declarations must be clear, unambiguous and legible.
expected_value_or_format: Clear + unambiguous + legible.

description: No declaration may be made in a manner requiring it to be read through the liquid commodity contained in the package.

applicability.exemption_conditions: Applies to declarations positioned so they would have to be read through the liquid.

expected_value_or_format: Declarations must remain readable without reading through liquid contents.

description: An outside container or wrapper must also contain all declarations required on the package, unless the outside container/wrapper is transparent and the declarations on the package are easily readable through it.

applicability.commodity_category: Packages having an outside container or wrapper
applicability.exemption_conditions: Transparent outside wrapper with easily readable inner declarations.

expected_value_or_format: Outer wrapper repeats all required declarations unless transparent/readable exception applies.

description: No declaration on the inner package is required where the inner package does not contain any declaration on its outer cover.
expected_value_or_format: Inner-package declaration requirement follows the specific proviso.

description: Required declaration particulars must be in Hindi in Devanagari script or in English; additional languages may also be used.

applicability.exemption_conditions: Other languages are permitted in addition to Hindi or English.

expected_value_or_format: Hindi in Devanagari and/or English; additional languages permitted.

description: Every package kept, offered, exposed for sale or sold must conspicuously bear the name and complete address of the manufacturer; where manufacturer is not packer, manufacturer and packer; and for imported packages, importer name/address.

applicability.commodity_category: Packages kept/offered/exposed for sale or sold
applicability.exemption_conditions: Capacity <=5 cm3 has an identification-mark alternative; additional requirement applies where commodity manufactured outside India is packed in India.

expected_value_or_format: Conspicuous actual manufacturer/packer/importer identity and complete address as applicable.

description: For packages of capacity 5 cubic centimetres or less, a mark or inscription enabling the consumer to identify the manufacturer, packer or importer is sufficient.

applicability.exemption_conditions: Alternative compliance for very small packages.

expected_value_or_format: Identifying mark/inscription for manufacturer, packer or importer.

description: Where a commodity manufactured outside India is packed in India, the package must also contain on the principal display panel the name and complete address of the packer or importer in India.

applicability.commodity_category: Commodities manufactured outside India and packed in India

expected_value_or_format: Indian packer or importer name + complete address on principal display panel.

description: The 'complete address' must enable the consumer to identify and locate the manufacturer, packer or importer and includes the specified postal/street/premises/city-State or PIN information.
expected_value_or_format: Address must contain the source-specified location-identifying particulars.

description: The manufacturer, packer or importer name must be the actual corporate name or, if unincorporated, the name under which the business is conducted in India.
expected_value_or_format: Actual corporate name or actual business name in India.

description: The weight of wrappers and materials other than the commodity must be excluded when declaring net quantity.
expected_value_or_format: Net quantity = commodity quantity excluding wrappers and other non-commodity materials.

description: Where a commodity is not likely to vary in weight or measure due to environmental conditions, the declared quantity must correspond to the net quantity received by the consumer and must not be qualified by words such as 'when packed' or similar.

applicability.commodity_category: Commodities not likely to undergo environmental weight/measure variation

expected_value_or_format: Declared quantity = net quantity received; no 'when packed' or similar qualification.

description: Where a commodity is likely to undergo environmental variation but the variation is negligible, the declared quantity must account for the variation so that the consumer receives not less than the declared net quantity; 'when packed' or similar qualification is not permitted.

applicability.commodity_category: Commodities subject to negligible environmental variation

expected_value_or_format: Declared quantity adjusted so consumer receives at least declared net quantity; no 'when packed' qualification.

description: Commodities likely to undergo significant variations in weight or measure due to environmental or other conditions may have the quantity declaration qualified by the words 'when packed', as specified in the Third Schedule.

applicability.commodity_category: Commodities subject to significant environmental/other variation
applicability.exemption_conditions: Significant variation must exist; Third Schedule specification applies.

expected_value_or_format: Permitted qualification: 'when packed' according to Third Schedule.

description: Quantity must be expressed in a unit of weight, measure or number, or combination, that gives accurate and adequate information to the consumer.

applicability.exemption_conditions: Subject to specific Fourth Schedule cases.

expected_value_or_format: Quantity declaration uses an accurate and adequate unit/combinational expression.

description: Except for commodities specified in the Fourth Schedule, quantity must be declared in mass for solid/semi-solid/viscous/mixed solid-liquid commodities, length for linear measure, area for area measure, volume for liquids/cubic measure, and number for commodities sold by number.
expected_value_or_format: Solid/semi-solid/viscous/mixed = mass; linear = length; area = area; liquid/cubic = volume; sold by number = number.

description: Where quantity is declared by mass, the manufacturer/importer/packer may additionally declare the number of commodities contained in the package.

applicability.commodity_category: Commodities with quantity declared by mass

expected_value_or_format: Optional count declaration in addition to mass declaration.

description: Where weight, measure or number alone is insufficient to provide full information about dimensions or number, the declaration must be accompanied by dimensions or number, or both, where necessary.

applicability.commodity_category: Commodities for which basic quantity declaration is insufficient
applicability.exemption_conditions: Additional dimensions/number required only where necessary for full consumer information.

expected_value_or_format: Additional dimensions and/or number as necessary.

description: Where additional information about the commodity is necessary to communicate to the consumer, it must appear on the same panel as the other information required under the Rules.

applicability.exemption_conditions: Applies when additional information is necessary.

expected_value_or_format: Additional information appears on same panel as other required information.

description: The quantity declaration must not contain wording that creates or tends to create an exaggerated, misleading or inadequate impression about the quantity, including terms such as 'minimum', 'not less than', 'average', 'about' or 'approximately'.

applicability.exemption_conditions: No specific exemption stated in the current provision shown in the source.

expected_value_or_format: Reject misleading quantity qualifiers such as 'minimum', 'not less than', 'average', 'about', 'approximately' and similar expressions.

description: The source records an earlier wording of Rule 12(6) and states that it was amended with effect from 01.07.2012 by GSR 748(E) dated 24.10.2011.
expected_value_or_format: Historical wording not to be treated as current where the source records the amendment.

description: For packages having capacity 5 cubic centimetres or less, quantity must be declared on a tag, card, tape or similar device affixed so it cannot be removed without opening the container, and the device must contain a mark or inscription identifying the manufacturer or packer.
expected_value_or_format: Securely affixed tag/card/tape/similar device; quantity + manufacturer/packer identification.

description: Units of weight, measure or number must be specified in accordance with Rule 13(2) or 13(3).

applicability.exemption_conditions: Subject to the specific unit rules and proviso.

expected_value_or_format: Units must follow Rule 13's prescribed unit hierarchy.

description: Quantities below one kilogram must use gram; below one metre centimetre; below one square metre square decimetre; below one cubic metre cubic centimetre; below one cubic decimetre cubic centimetre; below one litre millilitre.

applicability.commodity_category: Quantities below the stated base units
applicability.exemption_conditions: Subject to Rule 13 and specified alternatives at equality thresholds.

expected_value_or_format: <1 kg = gram; <1 m = centimetre; <1 m2 = square decimetre; <1 m3 = cubic centimetre; <1 dm3 = cubic centimetre; <1 L = millilitre.

description: Quantities equal to or above the base units must use kilogram/metre/square metre/cubic metre/litre respectively, with fractions expressed as prescribed decimal sub-multiples or specified smaller units.

applicability.commodity_category: Quantities equal to or greater than the stated base units
applicability.exemption_conditions: Subject to the equality alternatives in the proviso.

expected_value_or_format: >=1 kg = kg; >=1 m = m; >=1 m2 = m2; >=1 m3 = m3; >=1 L = L, with permitted fractional representations.

description: At exact quantities of one kilogram, one metre, one square metre, one cubic decimetre, one cubic metre or one litre, the manufacturer/packer/importer may optionally express the quantity using the smaller units specified in the proviso.

applicability.exemption_conditions: Optional representation at exact threshold quantities.

expected_value_or_format: 1 kg may be expressed as gram; 1 m as centimetre; 1 m2 as square decimetre; 1 dm3 as cubic centimetre; 1 m3 as cubic decimetre; 1 L as millilitre.

description: Numbers such as dozen, score, gross, great gross or the like must not be specified or indicated on any package.
expected_value_or_format: Reject quantity expressions using dozen/score/gross/great gross or similar number groupings.

description: No system of units other than the International System of Units may be used for furnishing the net quantity of packages.
expected_value_or_format: International System of Units only.

description: For items sold by number, the symbol must be N or U.

applicability.exemption_conditions: Applies specifically to number-based quantity declarations.

expected_value_or_format: Symbol = N or U.

description: Packages containing bed-sheets, hemmed fabric materials, dhoties, sarees, napkins, pillow-covers, towels, table cloths or similar commodities must declare the number and finished-size dimensions.
expected_value_or_format: Number of pieces + finished-size dimensions.

description: Where a package contains more than one piece of different dimensions, it must declare the dimensions and retail sale price of each different piece.

applicability.commodity_category: Packages containing pieces of different dimensions
applicability.exemption_conditions: Applies when multiple different dimensions are present.

expected_value_or_format: Dimensions + MRP for each different piece.

description: The dimensions and sale price must also be marked on each individual piece.

applicability.commodity_category: Individual pieces within packages covered by Rule 14

expected_value_or_format: Each piece carries dimensions + sale price.

description: Where dimensions and weight, or their combination, have a relationship to the price of a commodity, the quantity declaration must also include those dimensions, weight or combination.

applicability.exemption_conditions: Applies where the specified relationship to price exists.

expected_value_or_format: Quantity declaration includes relevant dimensions, weight or combination thereof.

description: Packages containing sheets such as aluminium foil, facial tissues, waxed paper, toilet paper or other types of sheets must state the number of usable sheets and the dimensions of each sheet.

applicability.exemption_conditions: Applies to the listed and similar sheet products.

expected_value_or_format: Number of usable sheets + dimensions of each sheet.

description: Bag-type container commodities must declare the number of bags followed by the linear dimensions of the bags, whether packaged in perforated roll or otherwise.

applicability.commodity_category: Bag-type container commodities sold for use as containers

expected_value_or_format: Number of bags + linear dimensions.

description: Square, oblong, rectangular or similarly shaped container commodities must declare the number of containers followed by length, width and, if required, depth.
expected_value_or_format: Number + length + width + depth where required.

description: Circular or generally round-shaped container commodities, other than cups or the like, must declare the number of commodities followed by diameter and, if necessary, depth.

applicability.commodity_category: Circular/round-shaped container commodities other than cups or the like
applicability.exemption_conditions: Cups and the like are excluded from this particular clause.

expected_value_or_format: Number + diameter + depth where necessary.

description: Where use of a container is related by label references to its capability to hold a specified quantity or class of commodities, the standard weight or measure references must be included in the quantity declaration.

applicability.commodity_category: Container commodities whose use is related by label references to holding capacity
applicability.exemption_conditions: Applies where such label references exist.

expected_value_or_format: Relevant standard weight or measure/capacity reference included.

description: Wholesale dealers, retail dealers and importers must not sell, distribute, deliver, display or store for sale any packaged commodity unless the package complies in all respects with the Act and Rules.

applicability.exemption_conditions: Applies to wholesale dealers, retail dealers and importers.

expected_value_or_format: Package fully compliant with the Act and Rules before specified commercial handling.

description: No retail dealer or other person, including manufacturer, packer, importer or wholesale dealer, may sell a packaged commodity at a price exceeding its retail sale price.

applicability.commodity_category: Packaged commodities with retail sale price
applicability.exemption_conditions: No specific exemption stated in Rule 18(2).

expected_value_or_format: Sale price <= declared retail sale price.

description: Where tax payable on a pre-packed commodity is revised, retail sale must not exceed the revised retail sale price communicated by the manufacturer or packer; the difference between marked and revised price cannot exceed the tax increase/fresh tax imposed.

applicability.commodity_category: Pre-packed commodities affected by tax revision
applicability.exemption_conditions: Specific tax-revision circumstances and provisos apply.

expected_value_or_format: Retail price <= revised retail sale price; permitted difference limited to tax increase/fresh tax.

description: Newspaper publication of a revised price is not necessary where the revision results from an increase in or imposition of tax under State legislation.

applicability.commodity_category: Packages affected by State-legislation tax revision
applicability.exemption_conditions: Only newspaper publication requirement is exempted.

expected_value_or_format: No newspaper publication required in the specified State-tax circumstance.

description: Revised prices may not be charged for packages unless the packages are marked as pre-packed in the month of tax revision/fresh tax imposition or the immediately following month.

applicability.exemption_conditions: Applies to charging revised prices under Rule 18(3).

expected_value_or_format: Package pre-packing month = tax-revision month or immediately succeeding month.

description: Where the revised price is lower than the price marked on the package, the retailer or other person must not charge more than the revised price regardless of the month in which the commodity was pre-packed.

applicability.exemption_conditions: Applies whenever revised price is lower.

expected_value_or_format: Sale price <= revised lower price irrespective of packing month.

description: The tax-revision provisions of Rule 18(3) do not apply to packages that are not required under the Rules to indicate the month and year in which they were pre-packed.

applicability.commodity_category: Packages exempt from month/year pre-packing declaration
applicability.exemption_conditions: Package is not required under the Rules to indicate month/year of pre-packing.

expected_value_or_format: Rule 18(3) applicability = exempt.

description: No wholesale dealer, retail dealer or other person may obliterate, smudge or alter the retail sale price indicated by the manufacturer, packer or importer.
expected_value_or_format: Original MRP must not be obliterated, smudged or altered.

description: The manufacturer, packer or importer must not alter the price on a wrapper once the wrapper has been printed and used for packing.
expected_value_or_format: Printed wrapper price remains unaltered after use for packing.

description: Retailers covered under VAT or Turn Over Tax and dealing in packaged commodities whose net-content declaration is by weight, volume or a combination must maintain an electronic weighing machine of at least accuracy Class III, with smallest division at least 1 g, with a facility to issue a printed receipt showing gross quantity, price and similar information, at a prominent place free of cost for consumers to check purchased package weight.

applicability.commodity_category: Packaged commodities with net content declared by weight/volume/combination
applicability.exemption_conditions: Applies to retailers covered under VAT or Turn Over Tax.

expected_value_or_format: Electronic weighing machine: accuracy Class III or better as stated; smallest division >=1 g; printed receipt facility; prominent/free consumer access.

Where 'when packed' is marked and deficiency is due to environmental conditions, punitive action against the dealer is not taken. If quantity conforms or deficiency is within MPE, the retail dealer may sell/deliver/distribute at a price determined on the basis of quantity found.
